result.quote: He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
result.reason: Verse 26:16 directly and uniquely states that Uzziah’s trespass was entering the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense. The wording clearly asks what he did after becoming powerful, and the edit preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
